description: This file defines an abstract class TutorService for interfacing with an AI tutor, and a mock implementation MockTutorService with canned responses.

classes.name: TutorService
classes.description: An abstract class that specifies the contract for an AI tutor service, including a method to send questions and receive responses.

classes.name: MockTutorService
classes.description: A mock implementation of TutorService providing canned responses for testing or development purposes.

methods.name: askTutor
methods.description: Sends a user question to the AI tutor and returns a response asynchronously.

calls: return "Great question! Let's break it down into a quick, 2-minute concept: $question"
